status: readiness audit only; no weights downloaded, GPU run, provider call, or validation
question: Can official AlphaFold 3 or Boltz-2 provide a practical smoke-test path for protein-ligand structure and affinity inference?

alphafold3.license: Source code Apache-2.0. Model parameters are governed by AlphaFold 3 Model Parameters Terms of Use and prohibited-use policy; parameters must be obtained directly from Google and are not treated as unrestricted MIT/Apache assets.

weights.size_note: About 1.02 GB from current HTTP metadata; do not infer installed/uncompressed footprint from this value.

installation_requirements.os: Linux officially supported; repository documents Docker and Singularity paths
installation_requirements.gpu: NVIDIA GPU compute capability 8.0 or greater; verified numerical accuracy on NVIDIA A100/H100
installation_requirements.reference_machine: Ubuntu 22.04, 12 CPUs, 170 GB RAM, 1 TB boot disk, NVIDIA A100 80 GB
installation_requirements.memory: At least 64 GB RAM recommended for genetic searches; deep MSAs may require substantially more
installation_requirements.gpu_memory: A single A100 80 GB or H100 80 GB verified for inputs up to 5,120 tokens
installation_requirements.databases: Full genetic databases approximately 252 GB download and 630 GB uncompressed; SSD recommended; database fetch documented at about 45 minutes without local SSD

inputs.format: One custom AlphaFold 3 JSON per input; dialect alphafold3; modelSeeds required; supports protein/RNA/DNA, ligands by CCD/SMILES/user CCD, covalent bonds, custom MSA and protein templates
inputs.msa: Data pipeline searches databases by default; inference-only mode requires precomputed MSAs/templates or explicit empty values
inputs.coordinates: The documented input is sequence/entity based. Experimental protein coordinates may be supplied as an mmCIF structural template; AF3 is a structure prediction pipeline, not a fixed-complex affinity scorer.
inputs.affinity: Official AF3 local inference documentation exposes structure/confidence outputs; no official local AF3 affinity prediction field or affinity validation workflow was identified in the reviewed sources.

alphafold3.runtime: Official documentation gives hardware and database-search timing guidance but no per-complex GPU wall-clock benchmark suitable for a 4090 budget estimate; CPU-only mode is unofficial and roughly 100x slower than GPU.
alphafold3.smoke_test: Possible only after obtaining Google-authorized parameters and enough environment; use the repository example JSON, run_data_pipeline=false only with prepared/empty MSA choices, and verify data test plus one inference output.
alphafold3.validation_limit: AF3 confidence metrics are prediction confidence, not experimental binding affinity, efficacy, or clinical evidence.

boltz2.license: Official repository states code and model weights are MIT, usable for academic and commercial purposes; third-party dependencies and automatic MSA service terms remain separate.

weights.download: Downloaded automatically/cached by the prediction command unless an explicit checkpoint is supplied
weights.size: Official README and prediction documentation reviewed here do not state a checkpoint byte size; do not budget disk or transfer from the AF3 size.

installation_requirements.install: pip install boltz[cuda] -U or editable GitHub install
installation_requirements.accelerator: GPU is default; CPU is supported but officially described as significantly slower
installation_requirements.msa: --use_msa_server can generate MSA through the default api.colabfold.com service; otherwise precomputed MSA is required for proteins

inputs.format: YAML preferred; one YAML or directory of YAML/legacy FASTA inputs
inputs.entities: Protein/DNA/RNA require sequences; ligands use exactly one of SMILES or CCD; protein MSA may be .a3m or multi-chain CSV, or omitted with --use_msa_server
inputs.coordinates: Boltz YAML supports optional PDB/mmCIF templates for protein chains, with chain mapping and optional forced backbone potentials. This does not document fixed ligand-pose scoring or direct use of template ligand coordinates as an affinity calculation.
inputs.affinity_input: Add properties: - affinity: binder: LIGAND_CHAIN. Exactly one small-molecule ligand is supported; it must be a ligand chain, at most 128 atoms after RDKit RemoveHs, and the docs recommend substantially below 56 atoms. Affinity is documented only for small molecules against protein targets; RNA/DNA/cofactor targets are explicitly unreliable.
inputs.affinity_semantics: affinity_probability_binary is a 0-1 binder probability intended for binder-vs-decoy hit discovery. affinity_pred_value is log10(IC50) in micromolar-derived units intended for comparing active ligands and optimization, especially small modifications; lower values indicate stronger predicted binding. It is not a universal experimental Kd or free-energy measurement.

boltz2.runtime: Official README claims Boltz-2 runs 1000x faster than physics-based FEP in its broad screening motivation, but provides no reproducible per-input wall-clock, GPU-memory, or RTX 4090 benchmark in the reviewed documentation. Treat runtime and memory as unknown until a local smoke test.
boltz2.evaluation: Official repository says updated Boltz-2 evaluation code and benchmark predictions are coming soon; this limits immediate independent reproduction of published affinity metrics.
boltz2.smoke_test: A bounded smoke test can use one small protein plus one ligand YAML, an explicit local cache/output directory, one diffusion sample, and either a precomputed MSA or the external MSA server. It must record package commit, checkpoint identity, input YAML, MSA provenance, output confidence, and affinity JSON.
boltz2.validation_limit: A smoke-test completion demonstrates installation and schema compatibility only. It does not validate affinity calibration, ranking on ROCK2, or transfer to cryoprotectant/IRI outcomes.

decision.practical_choice: Boltz-2 is the more accessible local affinity smoke-test candidate because official code and weights are MIT and its YAML schema has an explicit affinity property. AlphaFold 3 has stronger documented environment requirements and gated parameter terms, and the reviewed official local documentation does not expose an equivalent affinity output.
decision.supplied_complex_coordinates: Protein chains from a supplied complex may serve as templates. Neither reviewed tool is documented as a validated fixed-pose scorer for an already supplied protein-ligand complex.
required_before_validation: freeze ROCK2 protein and ligand identity/tautomer/protonation and chain mapping
choose and record MSA policy and external-service terms
obtain and hash model checkpoint without committing weights
run installation/data smoke test on an authorized local machine
benchmark wall-clock, peak GPU memory, cache and output size on the actual input
use a held-out or public affinity benchmark and report calibration/ranking uncertainty
keep affinity outputs separate from experimental efficacy claims
decision.budget: No compute or provider budget was consumed. Existing cumulative GPU authorization remains external to this readiness record; any future run needs a fresh quote/reconciliation and explicit bounded reservation.
